name: New Year Celebrations!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Level 60 instead of 70. Requires level 1 instead of 60. Pays 9s instead of 0. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Thunder Bluff is holding a celebration for the new year!  All day you'll find free booze there, and at night they'll put on a firework show!

It should be pretty nice... but Booty Bay is also having a party today; I bet it'll be even better!

Well anyway, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff needs a supply of Smoky Wood Pasture fare to help feed all the party goers.  Can you do me a favor and deliver it!

Thanks, adventurer!  Innkeeper Pala is in the inn near the bridge to Hunter's Rise.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Smokywood Supplies to Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, very good! These supplies will help feed all our people, here to celebrate the new year!I thank you, adventurer. You are in my debt. Please, take these coins... and heed my advice - drink heartily from the kegs outside, and join our revelers in a dance of celebration!
narrative.requestItemsText: Good day, champion! Did you come to Thunder Bluff for our celebrations?  Or are you here to rest a weary hoof between hunts?
